quest.title: With Flying (Graffiti) Colors
quest.description: While at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, you bump into someone who is super excited about spray painting...

dialogues.speaker: Pusaq
dialogues.text: Whoo! I think that's everything in order... Can't shake the feeling that something's missing, though...

dialogues.speaker: Pusaq
dialogues.text: #Well, hello, {NICKNAME}! You're just in time. Up for a game of graffiti spray?

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: Haha, there's no need to sound so nervous. It's just a game!

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: And in a game, no one gets hurt — at least not on my watch! I can't promise your clothes won't get a little messy, though.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm not very good when it comes to spraying graffiti...

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: Excuses, schmexcuses! C'mon, this game's good for even absolute rock-bottom beginners. Just start spraying and you'll have a blast!

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: The truth is, I was brought in to create something big, bold, and awe-inspiring to serve as a spray-painting subject...

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: Well, let's just say, while I did deliver something pretty epic, not everyone has the painting chops to do it justice.

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: So I did what any great artist would — I simplified the brief and placed more focus on the "process" of painting.

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: Simply put, I guess it's like... Hmm... Okay, I don't know how to put it simply. Let's just say, you'll understand once you try!

response.speaker: Pusaq
response.text: And by "try," I mean it's your turn to get out there and start making some art!

choices.text: Is this some sort of combat training?
